sloka: एष वै तत्र वैदेह्या विहगः प्रतिहारकः ।पक्षी माम् तु विशालाक्ष्याः समीपम् उपनेष्यति ॥४-१-५६॥
transliteration: eṣa vai tatra vaidehyā vihagaḥ pratihārakaḥ ।pakṣī mām tu viśālākṣyāḥ samīpam upaneṣyati ॥4-1-56॥

translations.english: 'Losten, O Lakshmana to the sweet warblings of the birds on the blossoming treetops of the forest. My love for her (Sita) enhances with their sweet voices.
